one_line: The paper develops a dimensionless aggregate energy benchmarking indicator (IEB) and empirically demonstrates it on two central sterile service departments of university hospitals in Morocco; steel/cement/clinker and an iron-and-steel benchmarking tool appear only as literature-review examples.
